description: A cream-gold floor-length court gown with a low square neckline and fitted opaque bodice densely decorated with gold geometric woven-looking patterns. Gold-and-brown borders define the neckline, front skirt panels, waist and hem. The sleeves sit low near the upper arms and a golden-brown patterned wrap drapes around the lower arms and down the sides. A broad ornate belt with a round central clasp secures the waist. The skirt has a modest walking opening below the knee. Small drop earrings, a pendant necklace, wrist bracelets and decorated gold-colored shoes are visible. Exact material fibres are uncertain.
